biography.plain_text: Anil 'Adu' Advaney is an Indian-born Dutch fashion entrepreneur and investor who helped create Mexx with Rattan Chadha. He later became president of the brand's wholesale and brands division before co-founding Fashion Fund One, a private-equity investor in apparel and accessories. That transition turned operating experience into an investment platform.

long_biography.plain_text:
Private-equity investor Anil 'Adu' Advaney has applied a fashion executive's eye to brands as well as art. Through Fashion Fund One, he backed European clothing and accessories businesses, emphasising active brand development. Its portfolio included Vilebrequin, which was eventually sold to a global apparel group.

A fashion conference in Delhi in 2005 sharpened Advaney's interest in contemporary Indian art. He assembled a collection spanning Indian and international artists and created a private gallery in The Hague. More recently, his wholly owned Movement Trading supplied investment capital to Sheep Inc, where he remains a board director.
